methodologyNotes: Dataset covers ten drip/automatic coffee makers (not espresso) spanning entry-level to premium segments, selected for high US search volume and active retail presence as of mid-2026. Primary sources were official manufacturer product pages (Moccamaster, Breville, OXO, Bonavita, Zojirushi, SharkNinja, Hamilton Beach, Cuisinart, Braun, Cafe) supplemented by major specialty retailers (Whole Latte Love, Williams Sonoma) and major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Bloomingdale's). Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-15: each priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline spec was re-checked against the official manufacturer page where reachable plus a second independent source. Brew temperature values are in °F; capacity is in US cups (5 oz per cup per convention); sca_certified is a boolean reflecting current SCA Home Brewer Program certification; warranty_years reflects the US limited warranty stated by the manufacturer. Unverifiable specs were set to null rather than guessed. All prices are US MSRP or current listed retail price in USD. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Moccamaster KBGV Select
products.priceNote: MSRP base colors; $389 for premium colors (e.g. Brushed Gold, Candy Apple Red)
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Moccamaster USA page: $369 MSRP (base colors; $389 for Candy Apple Red / Brushed Gold), 1.25 L / 40 oz / 10 cups, glass carafe, brew temp 196–205°F, ECBC certified / SCA approved, 5-year warranty. Release year 2021 confirmed (Caffe Tech lists it as the '2021 model'; Moccamaster describes KBGV Select as the current updated version). No built-in programmable timer or water filter; auto-off at 100 minutes.

products.name: Precision Brewer Thermal
products.priceNote: Current retail price at Whole Latte Love; original launch MSRP ~$299.99
products.provenance: Price $329.95 re-confirmed on Whole Latte Love (regular and current price). SCA Gold Cup certification confirmed (Gold Cup preset auto-adjusts temp/time to SCA standard). Capacity 60 oz (12 cups). Stainless thermal carafe. Programmable via My Brew (custom bloom time, temp, flow rate) and Gold Cup presets; 2-year limited warranty confirmed via Breville support. Brew temp range not published by Breville (PID-controlled) — null used rather than guessing. CORRECTED release year 2018->2017: BDC450 launched October 2017; the December 2018 9to5toys article cited in the original draft was a price-drop promo, not the launch.
